releaseNotes: PRVN Music v0.13.0 (Build 16): Fixed Play Together server unreachable false alarms by increasing failure tolerance to 5 and adding jittered retries; eliminated false 63,406ms sync drift display during stream loading; increased PO token retry limit from 1 to 3 with progressive backoff; fixed host reconnecting loop with active recovery snapshots; upgraded build to v0.13.0.
